# Fleet CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/ci/generate_fleet_cli_reference.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

This page is generated from the `cdnfoundry-fleet` command definitions, so it always
matches the tool. For a task-oriented walk-through, see the
[Fleet operator guide](../deployment/production-fleet-operator-guide.md).

Run `scripts/cdnfoundry-fleet <command> --help` for the same text in a terminal.

## Options for every command

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--vault` `VAULT` | encrypted SQLite fleet state |
| `--state-dir` `STATE_DIR` | unencrypted state directory for development and tests only; replaces the vault |
| `--output-dir` `OUTPUT_DIR` | Directory for the rendered host bundles |
| `--repo-root` `REPO_ROOT` | Repository checkout that holds the Compose files |
| `--config` `CONFIG` | Fleet configuration file to read |
| `--non-interactive` | Never prompt; fail when an answer is missing |
| `--dry-run` | Show what would change and change nothing |
| `--yes` | Answer yes to confirmations |

## add-node

Add a host to the plan.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name (required) |
| `--role` `ROLE` | Node role (one of `control`, `dns`, `dns-edge`, `edge`, `monitoring`; required) |
| `--region` `REGION` | Region label (required) |
| `--location` `LOCATION` | Location label (required) |
| `--hostname` `HOSTNAME` | Public host name of the node |
| `--public-ipv4` `PUBLIC_IPV4` | Public IPv4 address (required) |
| `--public-ipv6` `PUBLIC_IPV6` | Public IPv6 address |
| `--bind-ipv4` `BIND_IPV4` | IPv4 address the services bind to |
| `--bind-ipv6` `BIND_IPV6` | IPv6 address the services bind to |
| `--monitor-ipv4` `MONITOR_IPV4` | IPv4 address the monitoring role reaches this node on |
| `--monitor-ipv6` `MONITOR_IPV6` | IPv6 address the monitoring role reaches this node on |
| `--log-ipv4` `LOG_IPV4` | IPv4 address the log collector reaches this node on |
| `--log-ipv6` `LOG_IPV6` | IPv6 address the log collector reaches this node on |
| `--release` `RELEASE` | Release manifest version to deploy to this node |
| `--extra-env` `EXTRA_ENV` | Extra KEY=VALUE environment setting for this node; repeat for more |
| `--disabled` | Keep the node in the plan but deploy nothing to it |
| `--draining` | Mark the node as draining so it receives no new traffic |

## adopt-existing

Import the credentials of an existing host.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name (required) |
| `--role` `ROLE` | Node role (one of `control`, `dns`, `dns-edge`, `edge`, `monitoring`; required) |
| `--env-file` `ENV_FILE` | Existing .env file to adopt (required) |
| `--region` `REGION` | Region label (required) |
| `--location` `LOCATION` | Location label (required) |
| `--hostname` `HOSTNAME` | Public host name of the node |
| `--public-ipv4` `PUBLIC_IPV4` | Public IPv4 address (required) |
| `--public-ipv6` `PUBLIC_IPV6` | Public IPv6 address |
| `--bind-ipv4` `BIND_IPV4` | IPv4 address the services bind to |

## alert-webhook

Show or set where Alertmanager sends alerts (an https:// URL; optional, and an empty value turns notifications off).

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--url` `URL` | The https:// URL to save, or an empty value to turn notifications off; omit to show the current one |

## apply-config

Deploy re-rendered configs to the nodes whose bundle changed.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--plan-only` | Show the plan and change nothing |

## backup-now

Start a control backup on the active control node and wait.

No options beyond the shared ones.

## bootstrap

Install prerequisites on a node, deploy its bundle, and start it.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name (required) |
| `--plan-only` | Show the plan and change nothing |
| `--country` `COUNTRY` | ISO country code of a PoP (Geo-DNS placement) |
| `--continent` `CONTINENT` | continent code of a PoP (Geo-DNS placement) |

## clear-edge-bootstrap-token

Remove the one-time bootstrap token after successful mTLS enrollment.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name (required) |

## configure-backups

Set up backup settings.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--mode` `MODE` | How the feature is set up (one of `all-stateful`, `control`, `disabled`; required) |
| `--repository` `REPOSITORY` | Backup repository location |
| `--region` `REGION` | Region label |

## configure-edge-registration

Store a control-plane-created edge UUID and one-time bootstrap token.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name (required) |
| `--edge-id` `EDGE_ID` | Edge identifier shown in the admin panel (required) |
| `--bootstrap-token-file` `BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_FILE` | File that holds the one-time enrollment token |
| `--bootstrap-token-stdin` | Read the one-time enrollment token from standard input |

## configure-logs

Set up central logs.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--mode` `MODE` | How the feature is set up (one of `centralized`, `disabled`; required) |
| `--host` `HOST` | Host name or address |
| `--endpoint` `ENDPOINT` | Endpoint URL |

## configure-monitoring

Set up monitoring.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--mode` `MODE` | How the feature is set up (one of `colocated`, `dedicated`, `disabled`; required) |
| `--host` `HOST` | Host name or address |

## control

Optional two-node control plane: standby, promotion, rejoin.

No options beyond the shared ones.

### control add-standby

Add a warm standby control node to a running installation.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--name` `NAME` | default: the next free control-N |
| `--public-ipv4` `PUBLIC_IPV4` | No description. |
| `--public-ipv6` `PUBLIC_IPV6` | No description. |
| `--region` `REGION` | No description. |
| `--bind-ipv4` `BIND_IPV4` | No description. |
| `--bind-ipv6` `BIND_IPV6` | No description. |
| `--control-address-family` `CONTROL_ADDRESS_FAMILY` | the address family edges dial: the two control addresses are the nodes' IPv4 or IPv6 addresses (one of `4`, `6`) |
| `--extra-env` `KEY=VALUE` | per-node environment override, repeatable |
| `--replication-address` `REPLICATION_ADDRESS` | default: the standby's only private (VPN) address, read over SSH |
| `--active-replication-address` `ACTIVE_REPLICATION_ADDRESS` | default: the active node's only private (VPN) address, read over SSH |
| `--ingress-certificate` `INGRESS_CERTIFICATE` | default: the certificate the active node's Caddy already holds for control.`<operator-zone>` |
| `--ingress-key` `INGRESS_KEY` | No description. |
| `--ssh-port` `SSH_PORT` | SSH port of the new node |
| `--edge-timeout` `EDGE_TIMEOUT` | No description. |
| `--ssh-user` `SSH_USER` | No description. |
| `--deploy-dir` `DEPLOY_DIR` | No description. |
| `--ssh-command` `SSH_COMMAND` | command used to reach a node; replaceable for tests |

Compare secrets and replication on both nodes and record the result.

| `--deploy-dir` `DEPLOY_DIR` | No description. |
| `--ssh-command` `SSH_COMMAND` | command used to reach a node; replaceable for tests |

| `--deploy-dir` `DEPLOY_DIR` | No description. |
| `--ssh-command` `SSH_COMMAND` | command used to reach a node; replaceable for tests |

| --- | --- |
| `--old-active-is-powered-off` | No description. |

| `--deploy-dir` `DEPLOY_DIR` | No description. |
| `--ssh-command` `SSH_COMMAND` | command used to reach a node; replaceable for tests |

## deploy

Review, then install every host that is not installed yet, in start order.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--plan-only` | Show the plan and the DNS state and change nothing |
| `--location` `NODE=CC:CONTINENT` | repeatable; country and continent of an edge, for example pop-1=DE:EU |

## dns-names

List the DNS names to create and the host each points to.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--check` | ask the public resolver 1.1.1.1 whether each name points to the right host |
| `--json` | Print the result as JSON |
| `--standby-address` `STANDBY_ADDRESS` | public IPv4 of a planned control standby: also list the HA records to set before `control add-standby` |
| `--standby-name` `STANDBY_NAME` | name of the planned standby (default control-2) |

## doctor

Check the repository and the local tools.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print the result as JSON |

## init

Create the fleet state and nothing else.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--operator-domain` `OPERATOR_DOMAIN` | Domain for the control panel and API, for example ops.example.com |
| `--platform-domain` `PLATFORM_DOMAIN` | Domain that holds the platform nameserver names |
| `--release` `RELEASE` | Release manifest version to deploy to this node |
| `--acme-email` `ACME_EMAIL` | Contact address for the certificate authority account |
| `--dual-stack` | Plan IPv4 and IPv6 on every node |

## inventory

Show the hardware and system of every host, as last read; --refresh reads them over SSH first.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name; repeat for several (default: every node) |
| `--refresh` | Read the hosts over SSH now and record the result |
| `--json` | Print the result as JSON |

## list-nodes

List the hosts in the plan.

No options beyond the shared ones.

## management-networks

Show or set the networks allowed to reach the panels, the API, Horizon, and Grafana (CIDRs; an empty value removes the restriction).

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--networks` `NETWORKS` | Space- or comma-separated CIDRs to save, or an empty value to remove the restriction; omit to show the current ones |

## management-tls

Certificates for the control, grafana, and telemetry names.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--name` `NAME` | repeatable; the management names to change (one of `control`, `grafana`, `telemetry`) |
| `--cert-file` `CERT_FILE` | PEM certificate chain, your certificate first (set) |
| `--key-file` `KEY_FILE` | PEM private key without a password (set) |

## node-ssh

Record how to reach a node over SSH and pin its host key (the node must already authorise the Fleet public key).

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name (required) |
| `--host` `HOST` | Host name or address (required) |
| `--ssh-port` `SSH_PORT` | SSH port of the node |
| `--ssh-user` `SSH_USER` | SSH user for the node |

## public-key

Print the Fleet SSH public key; add it to root's authorized_keys on every node.

No options beyond the shared ones.

## remove-node

Remove a host from the plan; it does not stop or clean the host.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name (required) |

## render

Generate the host bundles.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name |

## restore

Restore a control backup into a control node.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name (required) |
| `--snapshot` `SNAPSHOT` | Backup snapshot to restore (required) |
| `--operation` `OPERATION` | preflight operation UUID, needed with --overwrite-live |
| `--confirm` `CONFIRM` | type RESTORE `<snapshot>` to proceed |
| `--overwrite-live` | allow restoring over a control node that holds data |

## rollback

Return nodes to the previous release and config.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | repeatable; default is the whole fleet |

## rotate-secret

Rotate a supported secret.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name |
| `--secret` `SECRET` | Name of the secret (required) |
| `--phase` `PHASE` | Rotation phase to run (one of `prepare`, `commit`, `abort`) |

## security

Known vulnerabilities in the running release.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--available-manifest` `AVAILABLE_MANIFEST` | a newer signed manifest to check for fixes |
| `--json` | Print the result as JSON |

## set-release

Adopt a signed release manifest for the first install (deploys nothing).

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--manifest` `MANIFEST` | Signed release manifest file (default: Fleet builds it for the release your checkout is on) |
| `--key-file` `KEY_FILE` | verify with this key instead of the trusted one |

## set-secret

Replace a supported secret from a protected file without exposing it in argv.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--secret` `SECRET` | Name of the secret (required) |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name |
| `--from-file` `FROM_FILE` | Read the secret value from this file (required) |

## setup

Interactive or config-driven full fleet setup, validation, and rendering.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--operator-domain` `OPERATOR_DOMAIN` | Domain for the control panel and API, for example ops.example.com |
| `--platform-domain` `PLATFORM_DOMAIN` | Domain that holds the platform nameserver names |
| `--release` `RELEASE` | Release manifest version to deploy to this node |
| `--acme-email` `ACME_EMAIL` | Contact address for the certificate authority account |
| `--dual-stack` | Plan IPv4 and IPv6 on every node |
| `--preset` `PRESET` | Starting layout for the fleet (one of `control-only`, `control-monitoring`, `dedicated-monitoring`, `custom`) |
| `--control-name` `CONTROL_NAME` | Name of the first control node |
| `--control-hostname` `CONTROL_HOSTNAME` | Public host name of the first control node |
| `--control-ipv4` `CONTROL_IPV4` | Public IPv4 address of the first control node |
| `--control-region` `CONTROL_REGION` | Region label of the first control node |
| `--control-location` `CONTROL_LOCATION` | Location label of the first control node |
| `--no-render` | Save the plan without rendering the host bundles |

## show-start-order

Show the order in which to start the hosts.

No options beyond the shared ones.

## ssh-defaults

Save an SSH login (default root, port 22) for every host that has none.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--ssh-user` `SSH_USER` | SSH user |
| `--ssh-port` `SSH_PORT` | SSH port |

## status

Show the fleet and the state of each feature.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print the result as JSON |

## test-connection

Test that Fleet can log in to hosts over SSH (the same test as Fleet web).

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | repeatable; default is every host |

## trust-release-key

Trust the Ed25519 public key that signs release manifests.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--key-file` `KEY_FILE` | File that holds the release public key (required) |

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name (required) |
| `--role` `ROLE` | Node role (one of `control`, `dns`, `dns-edge`, `edge`, `monitoring`) |
| `--region` `REGION` | Region label |
| `--location` `LOCATION` | Location label |
| `--hostname` `HOSTNAME` | Public host name of the node |
| `--public-ipv4` `PUBLIC_IPV4` | Public IPv4 address |
| `--public-ipv6` `PUBLIC_IPV6` | Public IPv6 address |
| `--bind-ipv4` `BIND_IPV4` | IPv4 address the services bind to |
| `--bind-ipv6` `BIND_IPV6` | IPv6 address the services bind to |
| `--monitor-ipv4` `MONITOR_IPV4` | IPv4 address the monitoring role reaches this node on |
| `--monitor-ipv6` `MONITOR_IPV6` | IPv6 address the monitoring role reaches this node on |

## upgrade

Show, then apply, a rolling upgrade to a signed release manifest.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--manifest` `MANIFEST` | Signed release manifest file (default: Fleet builds it for the release your checkout is on) |
| `--key-file` `KEY_FILE` | verify with this key instead of the trusted one |
| `--plan-only` | Show the plan and change nothing |

## validate

Check that the bundles render, and replace nothing.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--node` `NODE` | Node name |

## vault-backup

Back up the encrypted vault to the off-host restic repository.

No options beyond the shared ones.

## vault-restore

Restore the vault on a new workstation.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--snapshot` `SNAPSHOT` | Backup snapshot to restore |
| `--repository` `REPOSITORY` | Backup repository location (required) |
| `--password-file` `PASSWORD_FILE` | File that holds the backup repository password (required) |

## watch

A live table of every host: state, load, memory, disk, and containers.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--interval` `INTERVAL` | Seconds between readings (minimum 5) |
| `--once` | Read once, print, and exit |
| `--json` | Print each reading as one JSON line |

## web

Local fleet web on 127.0.0.1.

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--host` `HOST` | Host name or address |
| `--port` `PORT` | TCP port to listen on |
| `--monitor-interval` `MONITOR_INTERVAL` | Seconds between read-only probes of every host for the live view; 0 turns probing off (minimum 15) |
